meta_title: Nayra — View & Spa | Sea-view apartment with jacuzzi & sauna, Kavala
meta_desc: A sea-view apartment above Kavala, Greece, with a private jacuzzi and Finnish sauna looking out over the bay to the island of Thassos.
meta_ogalt: The bay of Kavala and the island of Thassos, seen from the apartment's bedroom balcony door.
meta_twdesc: A sea-view apartment above Kavala with a private jacuzzi, Finnish sauna and views to Thassos.
nav_brandaria: Nayra — View and Spa, back to top
hero_h1:
Above Kavala,
with the bay in every window.
hero_sub: A sea-view apartment with a private jacuzzi and Finnish sauna, looking out to Thassos.
hero_imgalt: The bay of Kavala seen from inside the bedroom, through an open balcony door, with the island of Thassos across the water.
apt_h2: The sea is the whole point.
apt_p1:
The apartment sits high above Kavala, so the town's terracotta rooftops
        fall away below the balcony and the bay opens up behind them. The living
        space runs open-plan from the kitchen through to the balcony doors, and
        the sea and the island of Thassos are visible from most of the rooms.
apt_p2:
It was built for slowness rather than sightseeing — long mornings on the
        balcony, an afternoon in the sauna, the lights of the town coming on
        below while you're still in the water.
apt_note:
Good to know — there is no parking at the property. Pets are allowed on
        request and may carry a charge. The hosts speak Greek and English.
apt_figalt: A table and two chairs on the balcony, behind a glass rail, looking over the rooftops of Kavala to the bay and Thassos beyond.
spa_h2:
A jacuzzi, a sauna,
and the bay through the glass.
spa_lead:
The spa room runs the width of the apartment, with full-height windows
        along the sea side. The jacuzzi sits against the glass, so the view from
        the water is the same one you get from the balcony — the town below,
        the bay, and Thassos on the far side of it. A timber Finnish sauna stands
        alongside it.

The apartment sits above Kavala on 7is Merarchias, with the museums and
      the harbour downhill and a run of beaches along the coast east and west.
